title: Wɔn a Wɔadi Awerɛhow no Ɔwɛn
intro: Worebɛhyia ɔkra bi a ntetewmu a emu dɔ sen biara asɔ no ahwɛ, a na n’ani nim nusu kasa nanso na ne koma nhwere anidaso da. Wɔ nnaadaa, akɔnnɔ, ne awiei koraa no nkabom ho asɛm bi mu no, saa Allah akoa a ɔyɛ ɔhotefo yi bɛyɛɛ boasetɔ ho sɛnkyerɛnne maa bere nyinaa. Hena na ogyinaa ɛyaw a ahintaw mfe no ano, na wɔsan nyaa n’ani ne anigye bio wɔ bere tiaa bi mu?
clues: Meyɛ odiyifo a ne din bɛyɛɛ boasetɔ ho sɛnkyerɛnne wɔ adehwere kɛse bi anim.
Wɔhyiraa me mmabarima pii, nanso afoforo ahoɔyaw gyee biako fii me nsam.
Na dɔ a mewɔ ma saa deɛ wayera no mu dɔ araa ma awerɛhoɔ nti m’ani danee fitaa, nanso mannwiinwii da gyese Allah.
Mesomaa me mmabarima no san kɔhwehwɛɛ nea mahwere no ne ne nuabarima no, na mehyɛɛ wɔn nkuran sɛ mma wɔnnyae anidaso.
Bere a asɛmpa kurafo no duu hɔ no, wɔde atade bi guu m’anim, na mpofirim ara wiase no mu daa hɔ bio.
Wɔfrɛ me Israel, na me mma dumien no mu na ɔman kɛse bi mu mmusuakuw dumien fi bae.

arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَن جَآءَ ٱلْبَشِيرُ أَلْقَىٰهُ عَلَىٰ وَجْهِهِۦ فَٱرْتَدَّ بَصِيرًۭا ۖ قَالَ أَلَمْ أَقُل لَّكُمْ إِنِّىٓ أَعْلَمُ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ مَا لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verse: And when the bearer of good tidings arrived, he cast it over his face, and he returned [once again] seeing. He said, "Did I not tell you that I know from Allāh that which you do not know?" (12:96)
